claim_text: Protein supplements such as whey can be a convenient way to address a confirmed dietary protein gap in strength-training adults, but they are not required when total dietary protein is adequate.
health_goal_or_outcome: Support safe, indication-specific recommendations and avoid unsupported supplementation.

population.other_context: Adults strength training who report low dietary protein intake.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: Relevant dietary and supplemental forms; verify exact product label and formulation.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS Exercise and Athletic Performance fact sheet discusses protein and exercise.
limitations: No universal whey dose; assess total protein, life stage, renal status and milk allergy.
Exact source passages and underlying evidence require full appraisal before approval.
